context: usePolling repeatedly fetches a URL on an interval and returns the latest data along with how many times it has polled.
explanation: Safe to merge. setCount(prev => prev + 1) replaces the stale closure over count (previously always read as its initial value inside the interval callback), the effect now returns a cleanup that clears the interval and marks the fetch as inactive, and url/intervalMs are added to the dependency array so changing them correctly restarts polling instead of silently keeping the old interval alive.
